2026-10-21, agy 1.4.4 (agy --version): CONFIRMED that with HOME set to a temp dir (copy of the OAuth token file so login works), agy -p loads a global ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md, a global ~/.gemini/AGENTS.md, and the workspace AGENTS.md. A one-line question returned all three codewords. Load order was not observed.

2026-10-21, agy 1.4.4: CONFIRMED that an agent file at ~/.gemini/config/agents/NAME.md with frontmatter name, description, and model is listed by agy agents and is runnable with agy --agent NAME, and that the main model can call it via the invoke_subagent tool. The model field accepts only the aliases flash, pro, inherit (case-insensitive) and an absent field. Files with model gemini-3.8-flash-low, gemini-3.8-flash, sonnet, or zzz-nonexistent-9 were silently not listed (not loaded).
